title: Gain Success Online, Faster & Smarter [FREE WEBINAR]
author: Tom Sliker
excerpt: When I talk with people about their struggles in building a professional online presence, not knowing where to start and insufficient time come up more…
html:
Join in and Get The 9 Essentials To Web Success!

When I talk with people about their struggles in building a professional online presence, not knowing where to start and insufficient time come up more frequently than anything else.

I get it. If you do a search on Google for anything related to "Getting started online," you're going to find a million resources who are all very qualified, yet they are going to be telling you completely different things. It makes it extremely difficult to get an answer of where to start, and the time that you hoped to be spending on your online presence gets spent doing research of where to start and what to do next.

If you’re building an online platform, you don’t want to miss my new webinar, 9 Essentials of Web Success. Watch it now. 

Join us today - Tuesday, July 25 - at 2:00pm - Learn SEO Strategy, Google Analytics & Search Console. Follow this link: http://bit.ly/WebSuccessWebinar (GotoMeeting)

What if I told you that you can skip the hours of confusing google searches, and join us for 30 minutes a week learning the 9 steps it takes to start a successful online presence?

In my new webinar series, The Nine Essentials of Web Success, I'm revealing my own system for Web Success, based on over a decade of successfully helping business grow their online presence and in return increase customer reach, brand awareness, loyalty & sales.

This program is designed to give business owners the tools, techniques, ideas and strategies for building a productive and profitable online presence. The 9 Essentials of Web Success is about helping businesses exploit the power of the web to increase sales, win new customers and increase profits.

My company, Broadstreet Consulting, has been helping small businesses harness the power of the web for more than 10 years. We have long-time clients who are actively engaged in growing their business, and building a strong online presence has been a long-term strategy.

Over the years we have developed the Web Success method - a series of actions, tools, and methodologies that you can put together to build a custom digital marketing system for your business. 

If that’s something you’re interested in, I’d like to invite you to a free webinar series that I’m hosting: The 9 Essentials of Web Success

-- Edited on August 16, 2017 After Web Success --

Our introduction to our webinar series was recorded on Tuesday, June 6, 2017 at 10:00 AM and Wednesday, June 7, 2017 at 3:00 PM EST.  This recording is below.

In the following weeks there were 9 follow-up webinar sessions to explore each of the 9 Essentials in more detail. 

  • Website Strategy, Content & Search - Tuesday, June 13, 2:00 PM
  • Content Strategy, SEO, & Pay-per-Click - Tuesday, June 20, 2:00 PM
  • Email Strategy, Content, & eCommerce - Tuesday, June 27, 2:00 PM
  • eCommerce Strategy, AdWords & SEO - Tuesday, July 11, 2:00 PM
  • Paid Search Strategy - AdWords Deep Dive - Tuesday, July 18, 2:00 PM
  • SEO Strategy, Content & Pay-Per-Click - Tuesday, July 25, 2:00 PM
  • Social Media Strategy, Content & SEO - Tuesday, August 1, 2:00 PM
  • Local Strategy, Storefront & Geo - Tuesday, August 8, 2:00 PM
  • Review & Rebalance, Your Future Web Strategy - Tuesday, August 15, 2:00 PM

My hope is that this program will help you -  business owners & marketing teams - think about your online marketing strategy, and make plans to reach your goals.

If you would like to improve your business's online presence, please join us by watching the video recordings.

The initial webinar, The 9 Essentials of Web Success, was completed on June 7, 2017, and is available below.
